database.stem: The minerals boom has brought about an economic boom, which in turn has meant that real estate values have ------- to record levels.
database.raw_text:
The minerals boom has brought about an economic boom, which in turn has
meant that real estate values have ------- to record levels.
(A) rose
(B) raised
(C) risen
(D) been raising
database.explanation:
本题需正确区分及物动词raise和不及物动词rise。to
record levels (创纪录的水平) 并非宾语，而是表示程度的状语，因此横
线处需填入不及物动词。因横线前有表示现在完成时的have，故选 (C)
risen。
